dct_creator_sm: Environics Institute for Survey Research (Environics Research Group, Toronto, ON).
dct_description_sm: There were 2 Focus Canada surveys conducted in 2019: Fall 2019 and Spring 2019. This dataset only refers to the Fall 2019 Focus Canada survey.

The Environics Institute’s Focus Canada public opinion research program (launched in 1976) tracks the evolution of Canadian attitudes on key issues, such as Canadian attitudes about immigration and refugees, regional perspectives on politics and priorities, influence in Canadian politics, and intergenerational mobility in Canada. This survey is based on telephone interviews conducted (via landline and cellphones) with 2,008 Canadians between October 7 and 20, 2019. A sample of this size drawn from the population produces results accurate to within plus or minus 2.2 percentage points in 19 out of 20 samples.
